lines.zh: 草原的草尖，我一株株点过去。
lines.en: I touch the savanna grass tips one by one.

lines.zh: 我翅上的圆环，一圈套一圈。
lines.en: Rings within rings on my wings.

lines.zh: 我贴着热风上升，翅不打弯。
lines.en: I ride the hot wind up without bending a wing.
A tree shadow moved.

lines.zh: 金合欢的枝太密，我抬高。
lines.en: The acacia branch is thick; I climb over it.

lines.zh: 云影掠过草原，我跟着走。
lines.en: A cloud shadow sweeps the savanna; I follow it.

lines.zh: 翅上的圆环，一圈追着一圈。
lines.en: The rings on my wings chase each other.

lines.zh: 一扇一停，我借草浪的力。
lines.en: One beat, one glide; I borrow the grass waves' lift.
The savanna wind carries me along.

lines.zh: 我飞过干河床，往高处去。
lines.en: I cross the dry riverbed and rise.
The anthill below keeps shrinking.
I dip low and skim a clump of dry grass.
One lap of the savanna and my wings ache.

lines.zh: 热气从岩面升上来，托着我。
lines.en: Heat rises off the rock and lifts me.

lines.zh: 水洼在前头，我加快扇翅。
lines.en: A waterhole lies ahead; I beat my wings faster.
My eyespots blink over the grass.
The wind died — the quiet itches.

lines.zh: 我停在草穗上，翅慢慢合拢。
lines.en: I settle on a seed head and fold my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 一只羚羊走过，我让开些。
lines.en: An antelope passes; I shift aside.
Flowers once bloomed on this savanna.
At noon the savanna wind dies.
The rain is not here yet, but I smell the soil.

lines.zh: 我躲进一片宽叶的影里。
lines.en: I hide in the shade of a broad leaf.

lines.zh: 翅上的鳞粉蹭掉了一点。
lines.en: A little of the scale dust has rubbed off my wings.
I hang among the twigs, rocking slowly.

lines.zh: 远处雷声滚过，我收紧翅。
lines.en: Thunder rolls far off, and I draw my wings in.

lines.zh: 草原上没风，我翅都懒得动。
lines.en: No wind on the savanna; I won't bother flying.

lines.zh: 草原上的我，翅膀带眼纹。
lines.en: On the savanna, my wings carry eyespots.

lines.zh: 你从尘土里走来，鞋边发白。
lines.en: You walked in from the dust; your shoes are pale.
The name's Ringlet Butterfly, remember.
You reach out, so I rise higher.
My wings rest right on the grass tip.

lines.zh: 太阳在你背后，我眼睛发花。
lines.en: The sun is behind you and my eyes blur.

lines.zh: 你站着的影子，比草高多了。
lines.en: Your standing shadow is far taller than the grass.

lines.zh: 你抬头找，其实我在你左边。
lines.en: You look up, but I am on your left.

lines.zh: 你帽子上落了一片草籽。
lines.en: A grass seed has landed on your hat.
On the savanna, you look up at me.

lines.zh: 我的眼斑睁开，正对着你。
lines.en: My eyespots open, aimed right at you.
A corner is missing from my wing rings.
Scale dust falls off me in a trickle.
A grass blade nicks my wing. It stings.
I fly crooked and drop into the grass.
My wing base burns, but I still want to fly.
One of my wings is pinned to my back.

lines.zh: 草籽粘在我伤处，甩不掉。
lines.en: Seeds stick to the hurt and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 我翅上那些圆环，一圈套一圈。
lines.en: The rings on my wings nest one inside another.
I crawl to the underside of a leaf.
A small tear in my wing lets the wind through.
Let me land on your bundle of grass first.

lines.zh: 你手上的花蜜沾着露水。
lines.en: The nectar on your hand is beaded with dew.
Savanna flowers, one after another.

lines.zh: 草原的草籽，我一天吃不完。
lines.en: Savanna seed, more than I can eat in a day.

lines.zh: 草原上的黄圈，是我画的。
lines.en: The yellow rings on the savanna are mine.
Lower the flower and I will come near.

lines.zh: 那朵花的花心，我还没吸。
lines.en: I have not yet sipped that flower's heart.

lines.zh: 停在你指头上，翅尖还在抖。
lines.en: Perched on your finger, my wingtips still tremble.
The sweetness bends around the wind to reach me.
The flower sways, and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 风袭草原的风，差点把我吹走。
lines.en: The windswept savanna nearly blew me away.

lines.zh: 你的帽檐把我扫了个跟头。
lines.en: Your hat brim knocked me head over wings.

lines.zh: 我翅上的鳞粉沾了你一手。
lines.en: The dust from my wings is on your hand.

lines.zh: 草原上的风，把我推着走。
lines.en: Savanna wind pushes me along.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的肩，又差点撞上。
lines.en: I swerve past your shoulder and nearly hit it again.
Sorry — I couldn't brake on the savanna.

lines.zh: 你走的风，把我推得打转。
lines.en: The wind of your passing spins me around.

lines.zh: 一边翅折了角，我飞得歪。
lines.en: One wing is creased, and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 我从你袖口擦过去，你抖了。
lines.en: I graze your sleeve, and you flinch.
Do not swat; my wing membrane is thin.

lines.zh: 两只蝶绕着同一根草穗。
lines.en: Two butterflies circle the same seed head.

lines.zh: 翅上的环纹，一圈套一圈。
lines.en: My wing rings nest one inside another.
The wind lifts us both from below.
One sway and I switch blades of grass.
I caught a bug — it's for you.
I circle the flower, singing a raspy song.

lines.zh: 风袭草原的这枝，我守了半天。
lines.en: Half a day I guarded this windswept branch.
Her wing rings are rounder than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，绕过蚁丘。
lines.en: We pass the anthill one behind the other.
The eggs will cling to the underside of a stem.

lines.zh: 这粒草籽，我用前足抱住。
lines.en: I hold this grass seed with my front legs.

lines.zh: 一小片干花瓣，我叼起来。
lines.en: I pick up a small dry petal.

lines.zh: 翅上的圈纹，在草里看不清。
lines.en: My ring marks vanish in the grass.

lines.zh: 我抓起它，翅上的环纹晃了。
lines.en: I lift it and the rings on my wings sway.
When the hot wind rises, I go up.

lines.zh: 草原的草籽，我一颗颗数。
lines.en: I count savanna seeds one by one.

lines.zh: 草原的干草屑，我叼了一大把。
lines.en: I have a beak full of dry savanna grass.
This twig will do for my nest frame.
That glint on the savanna is mine.
That bright seed on the ground is mine.
A grass blade dips, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我的眼斑转过去，对准它。
lines.en: My eyespots turn and fix on it.
Wings folded, I ready my drop.
That small bug rests on the calyx.

lines.zh: 草原上，我的眼斑环一圈。
lines.en: On the savanna, my eyespots ring round.

lines.zh: 我停在草尖，它还没抬头。
lines.en: I rest on a grass tip; it hasn't looked up.
The grass is too short to hide it.

lines.zh: 我扇了两下翅，定住高度。
lines.en: Two wingbeats hold my height.

lines.zh: 花蜜不够，我想要点别的。
lines.en: Nectar is not enough; I want something else.

lines.zh: 风把它的气味送到我触角。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent to my antennae.
The savanna wind turns me in circles.

lines.zh: 我绕着草茎，一圈圈收窄。
lines.en: I circle the stem, narrowing each loop.

lines.zh: 草原上你听得到我的翅膀。
lines.en: On the savanna you can hear my wings.

lines.zh: 草原的草浪里，我低低地飞。
lines.en: Over savanna grass I fly low.
The rings on my wings never stop turning.

lines.zh: 草原的风把我的圈纹吹歪了。
lines.en: The savanna wind bends the rings on my wings.
I am waiting for the wind to turn.

lines.zh: 它往左，我的影子也往左。
lines.en: It goes left, and my shadow goes left.
Beyond the dune, there is no way out.
My wings make almost no sound.
I sweep its back with my wing edge.

lines.zh: 翅上的鳞粉撒进它眼睛。
lines.en: Scale dust from my wing falls into its eyes.
Move, or I take you with it.
My front legs clamp down and hold.
A few small rings dot my wings.
The rings on my wings spin me dizzy.
I bite the base of its wing.
It struggles twice and drops.
I let go and it falls into the grass.
One wingbeat sends you on your way.
The cocoon splits; my wings are still wet.
Under a blade of grass, I dry my new wings.
The savanna wind blows me off course.
The grass was thick and I stumbled.
The night savanna is just cool enough.
My wing membrane is still soft; do not touch.
At the first gust, I take off.

lines.zh: 草叶上还有露，我先等等。
lines.en: Dew still on the grass; I wait.

lines.zh: 我在草茎上，慢慢撑开翅。
lines.en: On a stem, I slowly spread my wings.

lines.zh: 四周都是草，我认不出方向。
lines.en: Grass on every side; I cannot tell the way.
Fire nears and my wings curl.
I tumble and grab a stem.

lines.zh: 翅一湿，我就飞不起来了。
lines.en: Once my wings are wet, I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 草原蝶被震得翻了个身。
lines.en: The savanna butterfly was flipped right over.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翅膀，还在飞。
lines.en: An arrow through my wing and I still fly.
The spell sticks my wings together.
The flowers have wilted, and I am empty.
A flash of lightning, and my wingtips are scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的翅纹抹掉了。
lines.en: The void has wiped the rings off my wings.
